preamble: Fronting of the voiced retroflex affricate [ɖʐ] to [dz]. In Georgian, Proto-Kartvelian *ʒ₁ became ʒ [d͡z], while Zan and Svan reflect it as ǯ [d͡ʒ]: *ʒ₁am- 'brother' gives Old Georgian ʒmay beside Mingrelian ǯima and Laz ǯuma. Wiktionary's subscript-1 series (*s₁, *z₁, *c₁, *ʒ₁) is the Gamkrelidze-Machavariani 'hissing-hushing' series, which the Wikipedia Proto-Kartvelian consonant table (after Gamkrelidze 1966 and Fähnrich 2002) gives as retroflex [ʂ ʐ ʈ͡ʂ ɖ͡ʐ]. Polish mazurzenie (dż > dz) is filed under dʒ > dz, since most accounts derive the mazurating dz directly from the older palato-alveolar.

examples.from: Proto-Kartvelian *ʒ₁am- 'brother' (Mingrelian ჯიმა ǯima, Laz ჯუმა ǯuma)
